text: ただし…　うまく　とれるか　どうかは　わからんぞ！

structure.jp: うまく　とれるか　どうかは
structure.en: whether you can catch it successfully or not

patterns.name: 〜かどうか
patterns.explanation: かどうか after a verb means 'whether or not'. とれる is the 'can' form of とる. とれるかどうか = 'whether you can catch it or not'.

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: ん on the end of a verb is a short, old-man way of saying ない, 'not'. わからん = 'I don't know', 'there's no telling'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end makes the statement a strong warning, in a rough male way of talking. わからんぞ = 'there's no telling, mind you!'
